title: Course Schedule III
description: Find the maximum number of courses that can be taken given their durations and deadlines.
pseudocode:
1. courses.sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1])
2. time = 0
3. pq = new MaxHeap()
4. for [duration, end] of courses:
5.   if time + duration <= end:
6.     time += duration
7.     pq.push(duration)
8.   else if pq.size > 0 and pq.peek() > duration:
9.     time = time - pq.pop() + duration
10.    pq.push(duration)
